title: Temporal validation protected reference solution and review guide
answer: A strong submission for Temporal validation should complete this objective: Evaluate a time-ordered dataset. It should demonstrate the expected outcome (Avoid future-data leakage.), use a consistent and reproducible setup, report evidence rather than speculation, and address the limitation: Explain why random shuffling can be inappropriate for ordered observations.
explanation: Review the result for technical correctness and reproducibility. The automatic check only looks for TimeSeriesSplit, n_splits, cross_val_score and does not run the learner code. Explain why random shuffling can be inappropriate for ordered observations.
